knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Mould-like growth and a musty smell mean the learner stops, keeps people clear, records the growth and refers the job. Pressure cleaning or a stronger product is not the response, because it can spread spores.
Pressure cleaning can carry spores and water into the air and building materials. It does not reliably remove mould, and the lesson gives no authority to treat mould this way.
Material that may contain asbestos is not disturbed, and the job stops and is referred to a competent person for identification. Gentle cleaning or cutting back the sheet are not acceptable.
Only the approved product is used, as its label and safety data sheet direct. Mixing products creates unknown hazards, whatever the customer agrees to.
The lesson grants no clearance, licence or authority to remove mould, asbestos or other restricted contamination. Those requirements are not covered by this course.

practicalCriteria: Before starting, the learner inspects the surface and records any staining, odour, growth, loose material or damage.
When the learner finds an unidentified or possibly hazardous material, the learner stops, keeps people clear and does not pressure clean the surface.
The learner checks the label and safety data sheet of any product before use and does not mix products.
The learner keeps wash water out of stormwater and records the referral made.
passRule: Knowledge checks: 80% correct (4 of 5). Practical sign-off is assessed separately using a scenario-based observation with a photographed surface. This pass is not a clearance for any contamination and does not verify mould or asbestos handling.
evidenceRequired: Pre-clean observation record with location, appearance and odour
Site controller answers on past spills, chemicals, flooding and repairs
Product label and safety data sheet reference for any product used
stopWorkCriteria: The learner pressure cleans a surface showing mould-like growth or a musty smell.
The learner disturbs a material that may contain asbestos.
The learner allows contaminated wash water to run into stormwater.
